title: A mail that lands in Spam still has a way through: the inviter gets the invite link in the send answer only, the sign-in code step and Request sent page carry a dismissible Spam tip, and every switchable notification mail has a one-click unsubscribe that turns off only its group's email
steps: S1: Start a throwaway PostgreSQL (for example: docker run -d --rm --name reg202-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=t -p 127.0.0.1:55432:5432 postgres:16-alpine) and wait until pg_isready answers.

S2: From the TCH checkout run: TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:t@127.0.0.1:55432/postgres node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/team-invite-link.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/spam-tip.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/notification-unsubscribe.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/notification-mail.test.mjs
S4: Read the exit codes, the `# pass`, `# fail`, `# skipped` and `# cancelled` lines and the tests named below, then stop the PostgreSQL container.
expect: S2 and S3 exit 0 with 0 failures, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled.

'the inviter gets the accept link of the invitation mail, and only the inviter' passes: `results[0].inviteUrl` is the link the mail carries, no public table holds its token, and GET /api/team, /api/sites and /api/notifications (inviter and invitee) do not carry it.
'no link when nothing was granted: already on the team, or refused' and 'the link opens only for the invited address' pass.

'one click turns off that group’s email only, and stays idempotent', 'opening the link (GET) changes nothing by itself and offers the one-click form', 'a forged, tampered, expired or locked-group token changes nothing' and 'the locked join-request letters carry no one-click header' pass: after the POST, `notification_preference` holds only `mentions-replies` with inbox true and email false, and the next mention writes an Inbox row and sends no mail.
'C3-B: the invitation keeps three links, the join request two, and no brand link anywhere' passes: the invitation's hrefs are exactly Decline, Accept and Manage.
'storage that throws still shows the tip' and 'the script shows the tip, and a dismissal is remembered per tip' pass.

selectors.tip: [data-spam-tip="spam-signin"] inside #code-step, [data-spam-tip="spam-request"] on the join page; localStorage key `tracy.tip.<id>`
selectors.unsubscribe: GET/POST /api/notifications/unsubscribe?t=<token>; headers `List-Unsubscribe` and `List-Unsubscribe-Post` on the mail the notifier sends

evidence: 05/10/2026 (tracy-notifications-plan/review/spam-d1-d2-mockups.html): first mails from noreply@tracy.ai can land in Spam, leaving a sign-in code, an invitation or a join answer unseen. Chosen: variant C on the code step and Request sent (tip card), variant C on the wizard Done step (Invite link + Email sent rows). C1-B, C3-B and D3-A chosen 05/10/2026 in tracy-notifications-plan/review/spam-c1-c3-d3-review.html: Gmail shows Unsubscribe only with RFC 8058 headers, and the invitation mail measured in Spam had five links.
fence: Mechanism only: tracy-web under node --test with a stub mail transport and a real PostgreSQL; the wizard's Done step under node --test. Not covered: a real mail provider's Spam filter or its Unsubscribe button (the headers are checked, Gmail's own press is not), the clipboard of a real browser (checked by hand in Storybook 05/10, both themes).
